entries.definitionHtml:
Acrobatics:
If you would suffer Knockdown while adjacent to a Monster, you may Vault instead.
杂技:
若你与怪物相邻，在受击倒时改为撑跳。

Activate X:
Draw AI for the next X Mobs on the Mob track.
激活X:
为杂兵轨右侧的X只杂兵各抽取一张AI卡

Advanced Block:
While performing an Evasion Roll, treat 2 successful hits as evaded.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Block
Superior Block
高级格挡:
在执行闪避投掷时，视作成功闪避掉2个命中.

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
格挡
超级格挡

Advanced Bypass:
A Knight or Monster may voluntarily move through other miniatures. You cannot end your voluntary movement on a space occupied by another miniature.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Bypass
Superior Bypass
高级穿身:
拥有此技能的骑士或怪物可主动穿过其他模型移动。但你不可以在其他模型所占的格子结束主动移动。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
穿身
超级穿身

Advanced Defy:
While performing a Virtue test caused by a Judgement, treat 2 hits as evaded.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Defy
Superior Defy
高级违抗:
在执行由定断Judgement攻击造成的检定时，将2个命中视作闪避。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
违抗
超级违抗

Advanced Dodge:
Gain +2 Evasion bonus instead of the +1 granted by Dodge.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Dodge
Lesser Dodge
Superior Dodge
高级躲避:
改为获得+2 闪避加成

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
躲避
次级躲避
超级躲避

Advanced Reflex:
Move up to 2 spaces.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Reflex
Superior Reflex
高级反射:
移动至多2格。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
反射
超级反射

Advanced Reinforce X:
When you are about to resolve an Armor Roll, add X black dice to your Armor dice Pool.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Reinforce X
Superior Reinforce X
高级固防X:
当你执行护甲投掷时，向护甲骰子池中加入X枚黑骰。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
固防X
超级固防X

Afflict:
This keyword changes depending on the Kingdom. See the appropriate Trait card of the Monster you’re currently fighting for the definition.
折磨X:
此关键词的效果与具体王国相关。具体效果见冲突怪物的相关特质卡。

Ammo Reserves:
Additional X Charges per empty hand slot or support slot.
额外储备X:
你每有1个空手臂槽或助具槽，就多X枚充能。

Area:
When resolving the Power Roll against the Target of your Attack, additionally resolve it against all Monsters on spaces denoted by this keyword. Resolve the Power Roll against each Monster's AT individually (revealing or drawing their BP cards if needed), using this Attack's Total Power. Resolve Monster Responses only for the original Target of the Attack. Each Area keyword is followed by a description of the spaces it targets.
范围:
在对你攻击的目标结算强度投掷时，额外对此关键词范围格子上的所有其他怪物也结算强度投掷——用此攻击强度投掷你得出的一个攻击总强度，分别去对抗每只怪物的AT（展示或抽取BP卡，如果需要的话）。同时，仅结算攻击目标BP卡的响应。每个范围关键词都会跟随着一个范围格子指示。

Armor-piercing X:
Principality of Stone keyword. During the second ability window, discard up to X Armor tokens from the Target.
穿甲X:
巨石公国关键词。在第二技能窗口，弃置至多X枚目标的盔甲指示物。

Attack Re-roll X:
During an Attack Roll, you may re-roll up to X Attack dice with no additional cost. Remember that you can only re-roll each die once, regardless of the re-roll source.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Power Re-roll X
命中重投X:
在命中投掷中，你可重投最多X枚命中骰。不论重投效果来源，每枚骰子最多可被重投1次。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
强度重投X

Auto-X Y:
Place a number of tokens in the Knight Pool during the first ability window, where X is the type of token you can place, and Y is the number of tokens, for example Auto-break 2.
自动X Y:
在第一技能窗口，向骑士池中放入Y枚X指示物。

Bane:
Gain X Bane tokens.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Immune to Bane
灾祸X:
获得X枚灾祸指示物。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
免疫灾祸

Bane Limit X/+X:
Your Bane Limit becomes X or is increased by +X. Note: Bane Limit X doesn’t stack, but all +X bonuses are cumulative.
灾祸耐限X/+X:
你的灾祸耐限设为X，或提高+X。注意灾祸耐限X不可叠加，但是+X是可叠加的。

Black X:
During the second ability window, place X Black tokens in the Knight Pool. During the Power Roll step, the attacking Knight may use Black tokens in the Knight Pool to re-roll 1 Power die for each Black token used. They may turn 1 Potential symbol on each die re-rolled using a Black token into 1 Power, as if they had a Break token.
黑破X:
在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中加入X 枚黑破指示物。在强度投掷分步中，骑士池中每有1 枚黑破指示物，正在攻击的骑士能重投1枚强度骰。且对于重投来的强度骰，还可将1个潜力图标转化为1个强度（就像使用破甲指示物的效果那样）。

Block:
While performing an Evasion Roll, treat 1 successful hit as evaded. Advanced Block treats 2 successful hits as evaded; Superior Block treats 3.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Advanced Block
Superior Block
格挡:
在执行闪避投掷时，视作成功闪避掉1个命中。可能的亚型

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
高级格挡
超级格挡

Bloodletter:
This keyword is irrelevant in the Principality of Stone and Sunken Kingdom. It will become relevant in future Kingdoms.
放血:
此关键词在巨石公国与沉没王国中没有用途，其将在未来的王国发挥作用。

Boundless:
Terrain keyword. You cannot voluntarily move onto this tile. If a Knight is forced to move onto or beyond this tile or Board Edge, they die.
无边限:
你不可主动移动进此板块。如果你被迫移动进、穿过此板块或穿过版边，you die。

Braced:
You cannot be involuntarily moved or suffer Knockdown (you can still be Displaced).
支撑:
你不会被受迫移动或被击倒（但你仍会被位移）。

Break X:
During the second ability window, place X Break tokens in the Knight Pool. During the Power Roll step, each Break token in the Knight Pool allows the attacking Knight to turn 1 Potential symbol into 1 Power.
破甲X:
在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中加入X枚破甲指示物。在强度投掷分步中，骑士池中每有1个破甲指示物，正在攻击的骑士可将1个潜力图标转化为1个强度。

Bypass:
A Knight or Monster may move through spaces occupied by other Knights or Monsters, respectively. You cannot end your voluntary movement on a space occupied by another miniature.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Advanced Bypass
Superior Bypass
穿身:
拥有此技能的骑士/怪物可对应穿过其他骑士/怪物移动。但你不可以在其他模型所占的格子结束主动移动。可能的亚型

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
高级穿身
超级穿身

Cantrip:
During the second ability window, place X Cantrip tokens in the Knight Pool. When declaring an Attack, change each Cantrip in the Knight Pool to either an Opening or Break token.
戏法X:
在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中加入X枚戏法指示物。在宣布攻击时，将骑士池中每1枚戏法指示物分别视作机会或破甲指示物。

Chasm:
Terrain keyword. Knights cannot voluntarily move through Chasm spaces. If a Knight ends their movement on a Chasm space, they die. If they are pushed back, dragged or pulled through a Chasm space, they die. If a Chasm tile is placed under a Knight, they die. Note: Knights do not die from moving over a Chasm during Knockback, unless they end their movement on that space.
沟壑:
你不可主动移动进沟壑板块的格子。如果骑士在沟壑板块结束移动，骑士死亡。如果骑士被顶推或拉近至沟壑格子，骑士死亡。如果沟壑板块被放置在骑士上，骑士死亡。注意被击飞的骑士只有在沟壑结束受迫移动时才会死亡，否则就直接飞过沟壑了。

Choke:
If you do not have the Choked Condition card, gain it and place a black acrylic cube on 0 on the Heat track: this is your Choke Limit. Then increase the Choke Limit by X-1. Your Heat can never go below this limit. If you already had the Choked Condition card, increase the Choke Limit by X. Then, if your Heat is below the Choke Limit, gain enough Heat so that it is above the Choke Limit.
窒息X:
如果你没有窒息状态卡，获取一张。然后在你的烈度轨0的位置放置一个黑色亚克力方块，黑色亚克力方块上方的一格就代表你的窒息下限数值。然后将窒息下限提高“X-1”（例如当你受到窒息1时，你的窒息下限就会等于1）；如果你已拥有窒息状态卡，将窒息下限提高“X”。上述两个操作之一之后，如果你的烈度落到了窒息下限以下（即黑色亚克力方块压覆或超过了透明亚克力方块），将当前烈度提高到窒息下限（例如当你没有窒息状态卡且烈度为0时，受到窒息1将迫使你的烈度提高到1）。记住，你的烈度永远都不能低于窒息下限（即窒息会压缩你的“绿条”）。

Clash Scavenge:
Add X Exhibition or Full Clash Loot cards to the Loot deck, depending on the last Clash you resolved. If there are no more Loot cards to add, ignore Scavenge.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Consumable Scavenge
Kingdom Scavenge
Scavenge X
Upgrade Scavenge
冲突搜刮X:
向战利品卡组加入X张完全冲突或初步冲突战利品卡（与触发此效果的冲突类型对应）。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
消耗品搜刮X
王国搜刮X
搜刮X
改装搜刮X

Clockwork:
This keyword is irrelevant in the Principality of Stone and Sunken Kingdom. It will become relevant in future Kingdoms.
发条:
此关键词在巨石公国与沉没王国中没有用途，其将在未来的王国发挥作用。

Closing X:
During the second ability window, place X Closing tokens in the Knight Pool. During the Attack Roll step, each Closing token grants a re-roll of 1 Attack die and adds +1 to the result of each Attack die rolled during an Attack Roll.
空挡X:
在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中加入X 枚空挡指示物。在骑士攻击的命中投掷分步，骑士池中每有1 枚空挡指示物，给每枚命中骰的投掷结果+1，同时，骑士池中每有1 枚空挡指示物，攻击的骑士可重投1枚命中骰（无需其他费用）

Commit:
To attack with this weapon, gain +1 Heat.
负压:
要使用此武器攻击，需获得+1烈度。

Consumable Scavenge:
Add X Consumable Gear Loot cards to the Loot deck. If there are no more Loot cards to add, ignore Scavenge.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Clash Scavenge
Kingdom Scavenge
Scavenge X
Upgrade Scavenge
消耗品搜刮X:
向战利品卡组加入X张消耗品利品卡。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
冲突搜刮X
王国搜刮X
搜刮X
改装搜刮X

Cooldown:
Place 1 random card from your hand into the Cooldown area.
冷却:
将你的一张随机手牌放到冷却位置。

Crash:
The Knight subjected to Crash loses 1 Vigor and suffers Knockdown. A Knight suffers Crash each time a non-Mob Monster moves onto or through their space, as well as when any effect forces them to move onto an Obstacle or places an Obstacle on them.
冲撞:
受到冲撞的骑士会失去-1活力并被击倒。当怪物移动时进入或穿过被骑士占据的格子时，该骑士会受到冲撞；当骑士被任何效果受迫移动进障碍地形时，或当一块障碍地形板块放置到被骑士占据的格子时，骑士也会受到冲撞。

Cumbersome:
During the second ability window, if you successfully wounded with this weapon, exhaust it. Treat it as a voluntary exhaust.
沉重:
如使用此武器攻击对怪物造成损伤，在第二技能窗口，将此武器卡横置。该横置视作主动横置。

Daze:
During either the first or second ability window, if adjacent, you may turn the Monster (without moving it) in a way that would make it face directly away from you.
眩目:
在第一或第二技能窗口，如果你与敌人相邻，则可使敌人转至使你在其后方的朝向（但不要移动敌人）

Deadly:
During an Attack Roll, gain a Crit Chance on a natural 9–10 result.
致命:
在命中投掷中，将1枚普通命中骰替换为额外1枚关键骰。如果仅投掷1枚（关键）骰子，则改为在骰面9-10获得关键机会。

Defy:
While performing a Virtue test caused by a Judgement, treat 1 hit as evaded.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Advanced Defy
Superior Defy
违抗:
在执行由定断Judgement攻击造成的检定时，将1个命中视作闪避（大概就是对抗定断版的格挡）。可能的亚型

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
高级违抗
超级违抗

Delay:
Place 1 random card from your Hand into the Delay Area.
延迟:
将你的一张随机手牌放到延迟区。

Deploy:
During Clash Setup, at the start of the Monster Positioning step, you may move X spaces.
部署X:
在冲突设置时，在怪物放置步骤，你可移动至多X格。

Destructible:
Terrain keyword. When a miniature is involuntarily moved onto this tile, or when a Boss Monster moves onto this tile, the tile is destroyed. Note: a knocked-back Knight ignores non-Obstacle Terrain tiles they move through, so they will not destroy such a Destructible tile unless they end their movement on it.
可摧毁:
当骑士被迫移动进此板块时，或当怪物移动进此板块时，此板块会被摧毁。注意如果骑士被击飞，其将忽略穿过的非障碍地形。因此，除非其在可摧毁非障碍地形上结束移动，可摧毁非障碍地形不会被摧毁。

Devote:
Gain a Devotion token.
虔信:
获得一枚虔信指示物。

Devote to:
Gain the Saint X card if you don’t have it already. Then, gain a Devotion token.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Immune to X
虔信于X:
获得圣徒X卡（如果你尚未拥有圣徒X卡）。然后，获得一枚虔信指示物.

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
免疫X

Difficult Terrain:
Terrain keyword. If, during voluntary movement, a Knight moves through any number of Difficult Terrain tile spaces, they move one less space. Monsters on Difficult Terrain have -1 AT.
困难地形:
地形关键词。如果，在主动移动过程中，骑士移动路径上存在至少一格困难地形格子，则该次主动移动需比原本少移动1格。占据有困难地形格子的怪物获得-1AT。

Discard:
Place 1 random card from your Hand into the Discard area.
弃置:
从手牌随机弃置1张卡至你骑士面板的弃置位置。

Displace:
Move the Displaced Target to an empty space adjacent to its current position. If a Knight is Displaced and there is no space they can legally be Displaced to, they die instead. If a Monster is Displaced and there is no space it can legally be Displaced to, place it on the closest empty space instead.
位移:
将被位移的目标移动到与其当前格子相邻的一个空格子。如果骑士在受到位移时，无任何合规的格子可移动，直接死亡。

Diversion:
During the second ability window, place a Diversion token in the Knight Pool. An attacking Knight may use a Diversion token from the Knight Pool to ignore Fail Responses until the end of their Attack. Improved Diversion instead allows the Knight to ignore all Responses until the end of their Attack.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Improved Diversion
扰乱:
在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中加入1枚扰乱指示物。执行攻击的骑士可使用1枚扰乱指示物来忽略怪物的Fail响应（效果持续到其攻击结束）。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
高级扰乱

Dodge:
When you are about to resolve an Evasion Roll, gain +1 Evasion bonus for this roll. Lesser Dodge grants +1 only if you have no other Evasion bonuses; Advanced Dodge grants +2 instead; Superior Dodge grants +3 instead.

Related Keyword/Subtype also see:
Advanced Dodge
Lesser Dodge
Superior Dodge
躲避:
当你要执行一次闪避投掷时，该投掷获得+1 闪避加成。可能的亚型。

相关词条/亚型 请查看:
高级躲避
次级躲避
超级躲避

Doomed:
During this Monster Attack, Knights cannot re-roll the Evasion Roll or Judgement test using Heat.
厄运:
在怪物攻击中，骑士不可使用烈度在闪避投掷与定断检定中重投。

Drag X:
If the target is adjacent, the source moves X spaces directly away from the target. Then move the target miniature X spaces along the path the source took. At the end of the Drag, turn the source to face the affected miniature.

Other miniatures: If the source is a non-Mob Monster, the dragged Knight can move through spaces occupied by other miniatures. If a Knight ends involuntary movement on a space with another miniature, the other miniature is Displaced. If the source is a Mob Monster or a Knight, stop resolving Drag if it is about to enter a space occupied by another miniature.

Terrain: The affected miniature must resolve the effects of all Terrain tiles it moves through.

Destructible Obstacles: If a Knight is about to be dragged into a Destructible Obstacle (such as a Column), remove the Terrain tile from the Clash Board, the Knight suffers Crash, then continue the Drag.

Indestructible Obstacles: If a Knight is about to be dragged into an Indestructible Obstacle, it suffers Crash and the Drag stops.

Knight Timing: A Knight may use Drag X during either the first or second ability window.

Drag toward: Instead of moving straight away from the target, the source moves toward and past the specified space along the shortest path, until the Target can enter the specified space or up to the Drag value. Then move the Target along the path the source took until adjacent to the source.
拖拽X:
目标与来源相邻时，来源向远离目标方向直线移动X格，目标沿同样路径移动X格，来源转向目标。首领拖拽骑士可穿过其他模型，结束于其他模型格子则将其位移；杂兵拖拽时来源要进入其他模型格子则结束。目标结算沿途地形：进入可摧毁障碍时移除障碍、受到冲撞并继续；遇不可摧毁障碍时受到冲撞，沿边缘向怪物按最短路径继续。骑士可在攻击第一或第二技能窗口使用。向指定位置拖拽时，来源沿最短路径到指定位置，再保持方向移动一格，目标沿同样路径移动到指定位置。

详见规则书文本框。

Dwell:
Sunken Kingdom keyword. Move the Monster miniature to the closest unoccupied space on a Swamp Terrain tile.
沼栖:
沉没王国关键词. 将怪物模型移动到最近的未被占据的沼泽地形板块格子上。

Envenomed X:
During the second ability window, if you dealt a Wound, place X Break tokens in the Knight Pool. Then, for each 1 Power above the AT of the wounded BP card, place 1 additional Break token in the Knight Pool, up to X additional tokens.
淬毒X:
若你的攻击成功造伤，在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中放入X 枚破甲指示物。然后，如果本次攻击你的强度比BP的 高1点或更多，则你可再额外向骑士池中放入至多X枚破甲指示物，且此枚数不可超过上述强度比AT高出的数值。

Escalate X:
Escalate X lowest level AI cards (remove each one from the AI deck and shuffle in a card one level higher), one at a time. Then do the same for the BP deck. Do not look at the removed cards.
晋升X:
晋升X张最低阶BP卡（移除1张最低阶，然后再洗入1张高一阶BP），1张接1张地操作，之后再对AI卡组执行同样次数的晋升操作。不要查看移除的BP/AI卡。

Falsity:
During the Attack Roll step, you may re-roll your Crit die without gaining Heat. If you re-roll your Crit die while it is already a hit, immediately Zeal 1.
虚晃:
在命中投掷分步，你可重投你的关键骰（不需要获得烈度）。如果，你重投的是已投出命中的关键骰，立刻狂热1（在第二技能窗口，向你的骑士面板上放置1枚狂热指示物）

Fire X:
During the second ability window, place X Fire tokens in the Knight Pool. During the Power Roll step, each Fire token in the Knight Pool allows the attacking Knight to turn 1 Potential symbol into 1 Power. You may use other tokens to turn Potential into Power first, but if you cannot, you must use as many Fire tokens from the Pool as possible. During the Clear the Knight Pool step, leave all but one unused Fire token in the Knight Pool: remove the used tokens and one additional unused Fire token.
火焰X:
在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中加入X枚火焰指示物。在强度投掷分步，骑士池中每有1 个火焰指示物，正在攻击的骑士能将1 个潜力图标转化为1 个强度。你必须尽可能使用火焰指示物（但可先使用其他指示物）。在清理骑士池步骤，移除“所有使用的火焰指示物外加1枚未使用火焰指示物”，剩余火焰指示物予以保留。

Fleisch:
During the second ability window, place X Fleisch tokens in the Knight Pool.
肉肉X:
在第二技能窗口，向骑士池中加入X枚肉肉指示物。

Forced Vault:
If the source is adjacent to the target, place the affected miniature on a space in a straight line from the source, on the opposite side of the source and adjacent to it. 目标沿最短路径向来源移动X格，来源再转向目标。首领拉近骑士时骑士可穿过其他模型，结束于其他模型格子则将其位移；杂兵拉近时目标要进入其他模型格子则结束。目标结算沿途地形：进入可摧毁障碍时移除障碍、受到冲撞并继续；遇不可摧毁障碍时受到冲撞，沿边缘向怪物按最短路径继续。目标已与来源相邻或移动到相邻时结束拉近。骑士可在攻击第一或第二技能窗口使用。

详见规则书文本框。

Pushback X:
Turn the source toward the affected miniature. Then move up to X spaces in that direction, pushing it in a straight line.

Other miniatures: If the source is a non-Mob Monster, the pushed Knight can move through spaces occupied by other miniatures. If a Knight ends involuntary movement on a space with another miniature, the other miniature is Displaced. If the source is a Mob Monster, stop Pushback if the affected miniature is about to enter another miniature's space.

Terrain: The affected miniature must resolve the effects of all Terrain tiles it moves through. If the affected miniature is not adjacent, first move the source toward it along the shortest possible path.

Destructible Obstacles: If a Knight is about to be pushed into a Destructible Obstacle, remove the tile from the Clash Board, the Knight suffers Crash, then continue Pushback.

Indestructible Obstacles: If a Boss Monster would push a Knight into one, Displace the Knight to an adjacent space that lets the Monster enter the Knight's former space, then continue Pushback. If Displacement is impossible, the Knight dies; the Monster enters the Knight's former space and Pushback stops. If a Mob Monster would push a Knight into one, stop Pushback and the Knight suffers Crash. If a Knight would push a Mob Monster into one, stop Pushback and resolve the Terrain's effect, if any.

Board Edge: Displace the affected Knight or Monster to an adjacent space that lets the source enter its former space, then continue Pushback. If Displacement is impossible, Pushback stops when the source is a Knight or Mob; when the source is a non-Mob Monster, the target dies.

Knight Timing: A Knight may resolve Pushback X during either the first or second ability window of their Attack, excluding Attacks with a Ranged X-Y Weapon, or when specifically instructed to resolve it immediately.

Pushback toward: Instead of pushing the Target in a straight line, push it along the shortest path to the specified space.
顶推X:
来源转向目标，沿目标方向直线移动X格并推动目标；若不相邻，先沿最短路径接近至相邻，再顶推剩余格数。首领顶推骑士时骑士可穿过其他模型，结束于其他模型格子则将其位移；杂兵顶推时目标要进入其他模型格子则结束。目标结算沿途地形。骑士进入可摧毁障碍时移除障碍、受到冲撞并继续；骑士顶推怪物进入可摧毁障碍时移除障碍，结算地形效果并继续。骑士被首领顶推进不可摧毁障碍时，位移至相邻格，首领进入其原格并继续；无法位移则骑士死亡，首领进入其原格后结束。杂兵顶推骑士遇不可摧毁障碍时结束并使骑士受到冲撞；骑士顶推怪物遇不可摧毁障碍时结束并结算地形效果。目标将穿过版边时位移至相邻格，来源进入其原格并继续；骑士无法位移时，首领为来源则目标死亡并结束，骑士或杂兵为来源则结束。骑士可在攻击第一或第二技能窗口使用，远程X-Y武器攻击仅第二窗口可用；收到结算顶推指示时也可立即使用。向指定位置顶推时沿最短路径移动，使目标最终到达指定位置。
